name: Saikoukyuu Inran Kagu ~Umineko no ○ku Koro ni~
original_name: 最高級淫乱家具 ～うみねこの○く頃に～
source:
Saya** is employed to a mistress of the house. Having been born in unfortunate circumstances, she still managed to live a peaceful and quiet life in itself.

However, these happy idle days of her life are soon to end.

The mistress of the house ordered the girl to perform sexual services...

This secondary title features Saya** from Umin*ko no Naku K*ro ni 18+ only novel game where she is assaulted by a mysterious tentacle monster along with the mistress of the house.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ038800.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Saya**受雇于一位女主人。她出身坎坷，却仍设法过着平静安稳的生活。

然而，她这段幸福闲适的日子很快就要结束。

女主人命令女孩提供性服务……

这部衍生作品以《Umin*ko no Naku K*ro ni》中的Saya**为主角。在这款仅限18岁以上游玩的小说游戏中，她与女主人一同遭到神秘触手怪物侵犯。

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ038800.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
